name: Hypostatic union

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest Word before the assumption of flesh.

TANCH.justification: The final boundary containing the totality of the two natures.

AFWD.justification: The directed movement of the divine toward the human state.

AREV.justification: The self-emptying descent from divine glory into servant form.

CLINK.justification: The sequential exchange of properties between the two natures.

IMSCRIB.justification: The underlying subject that remains identical to itself across both natures.

FSPLIT.justification: The distinction into full divinity and full humanity without confusion.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the single person from the two distinct natures.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative operation of the divine nature.

EVALF.justification: The distinct operation of the human nature in submission.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous operation of both divine and human wills in a single act.

IFIX.justification: The irreversible historical fixation of God becoming man.

phase_3.void_description: The silence of the Father before the Word is spoken.
phase_3.true_description: The uncreated light and power of the Godhead.
phase_3.false_description: The finite limitations and mortality of the manhood.
phase_3.both_description: The mystery of the God-man existing in two natures simultaneously.

steps.domain_action: The Logos exists eternally in the bosom of the Father.
The Logos recognizes its own divine essence as the second person of the Trinity.
The Logos descends through kenosis to take the form of a servant.
The single hypostasis branches to manifest in two distinct natures.
The divine nature remains fully active and infinite.
The divine nature permeates the human nature through grace.
The human nature remains fully active and finite.
The human nature experiences suffering and growth.
Both natures operate in a single theandric mystery without separation.
The two natures are held in the unity of the single person.
The properties of the humanity are predicated of the person of the Word.
The union is permanently recorded in the flesh of the resurrected Christ.
The system is sealed in the eternal session at the right hand of the Father.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit effecting the conception in the womb.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The perichoresis or mutual indwelling of the natures.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Sacred Scriptures and Apostolic Tradition.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The fullness of time as determined by the Father.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The kenotic self-emptying of the Logos.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The transcendent simplicity of the unincarnate Word.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The glorified humanity joined eternally to the Godhead.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The divine essence suffers no change or loss through the union.
